protocol.scope: local CPU <=4 workers x 1 torch thread; frozen u195450 encoder/private network/gameplay; no PPO, mainline writes, remote jobs or new compute rental

split.test: new seed base 20261114411, reps 40..47, 320 matches; all prior tests excluded

protocol.samples: round 3 threshold 0/20/50; three decisions per match where a subsequent opponent Play exists
protocol.target: 11 public action types of the first subsequent opponent Play in this round, after our observed chosen action; no opponent private inputs
protocol.history: only completed rounds 0..2; frozen causal encoding; all public seats/phases; current round never enters the old-history branch
protocol.common: native own private query, current-round-only frozen state, own chosen action, own seat, current length/round/threshold, current public profile
protocol.representation: all 12 relative-seat x previous-round groups plus BOS; public group IDs and log token counts available to BOTH architectures; no target answer position supplied
protocol.original: linear QKV attention over all old tokens; 8 heads; internal dimension 128 small / 256 large; output 128
protocol.improved: token MLP 128->64/128 LeakyReLU->128; mean AND max within each of 13 public groups; 256->128 merge; attention over groups with internal dimension 32/128, 8 heads; output 128
protocol.fairness: matched reader parameter budgets: 67840 vs 67872 small, 133760 both large; same 128-d output and downstream head; common fresh initialization rule, Q/K normalization, train-only input statistics; original means original attention architecture, not a claim of preserving checkpoint reader weights
protocol.controls: current-only baseline; equal downstream residual head with zero history (current_extra); privileged identity diagnostic; raw public profile; frozen pretrained old-history attention; fixed same-seat/threshold donor history at test
protocol.prediction_head: frozen per-seed current-only baseline + zero-initialized residual 256->64 LeakyReLU->11; train-calibrated history BatchNorm; branch may change only copied diagnostic modules
protocol.base_head: standardized current context ->128 LeakyReLU ->11, initialized to train class prior

optimization.loss: pool/match-weighted multiclass cross entropy, no class rebalance

protocol.selection: weighted validation Brier every 200 steps, including zero, then rate per seed; all choices sealed before test scoring
protocol.metrics: 11-class Brier primary; log loss, accuracy and coarse pass/single/bomb/other secondary; each match equal within type
protocol.comparisons: four models versus current_extra and versus their own shuffled-input predictions; size effects within each architecture; architecture effects within each size; 12 prespecified contrasts with simultaneous alpha=0.05/12 bootstrap intervals
protocol.uncertainty: 5000 paired match-seed cluster bootstraps, stratified by 20 fixed opponent types, preserve two team orientations and all captures; optimizer seeds averaged, not additional data
protocol.limitation: controlled homogeneous-opponent teams, three prior rounds, fixed known pool; next-action prediction not strategy adaptation or strength; expanding only reader capacity

same-type-protocol.declared_before: any fresh test prediction or score; main training still in progress
same-type-protocol.purpose: secondary same-opponent different-match history control, to distinguish opponent type from match-specific traces
same-type-protocol.selection: same heldout split, exact own seat and type, different dealt seed; prefer same capture threshold
same-type-protocol.scope: additional inference only, no training or model selection

coverage.description: Original collector requires an own non-forced decision after the public-event threshold; no missing sample is filled or dropped based on target class.
